about: Guide photographs pinned by Commons file title after a person (or the reviewing agent) looked at the image and confirmed it shows the destination. A pinned file is fetched by title, not by search, so search ranking cannot change it; it still passes the app's licence, attribution and host checks. 'aliases' are the names in the file title that identify the place; 'why' says how that name relates to the destination when it differs from the guide's place name.
